spans.text: The members of the Blackseal Order are general upper-crust individuals, such as businessmen, aristocrats, royalty, or other important individuals. Their base level of members that possess a rank are the Letterheads, who are the hired aids of upper ranks, but still require a level of distinction to reach this rank. Above them stand Directors, who are the wealthy and influential among them, and at the top of their chapters’ leadership are the Wordless Masters, who are leaders with powerful personalities who directly serve the enigmatic interests of Hightrankul. The Blackseal Order is run with one underpinning ideal: mortals cannot expect their wealth or influence to follow them to the next life, but in return for their service in life Hightrankul promises them an afterlife befitting their station and pedigree.
